# Image Difference Generator

The Apify actor [`apify/image-diff`](https://apify.com/apify/image-diff) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.14**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Returns a difference of two given images as JPEG or PNG image.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/image-diff) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-image-diff@0.0.14#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      imageUrl1: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `imageUrl1` | string | yes |  | The first image URL — URL of the first image to be diffed. |
| `imageUrl2` | string | yes |  | The second image URL — URL of the second image to be diffed. |
| `outputAsJpeg` | boolean |  |  | Output as JPEG — Outputs resulting image in JPEG format. Default is PNG. |
| `pixelmatchOptions` | object |  | `{"threshold":0.1}` | Pixelmatch options — Options for pixelmatch package that is used image comparison. |
| `proxy` | object | yes | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — Sets the proxy configuration |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
